thread:
jordan: Heads up — noticed large spike in NCCL TCP traffic and cluster-wide allreduce stalls after rolling kernel+driver to the 2026-03 build on cluster-gpu-west.
sasha: Saw that too. Jobs on mixed H100/A100 pools regressed — throughput down ~6x, some jobs timed out with ncclAllReduce stalls.
anita: Error from a failing job:
```
NCCL WARN Overall : NET/Socket fallback activated, transport=NET
nccl: UnhandledCudaError at op allreduce
```
anita: Also `nvidia-smi topo -m` now reports a bunch of Xs where NVLink used to be detected for some A100 nodes.
mike: Can confirm. On one H100 node `nvidia-smi topo -m` still shows NVLink, but adjacent A100 shows PCIe only. It looks like P2P discovery is flapping.
ryan: dmesg on the problematic nodes shows repeated PCI BAR probe warnings after the kernel bump, plus `pci 0000:81:00.0: BAR 2: no space for [mem size 0x80000000]` — could be causing driver to disable P2P ranges.
jordan: opsbot posted the deploy marker: Ops Deploy 2026-03-10 04:12 UTC -> kernel-5.19.x + nvidia-driver-535.2
opsbot: incident created: #INC-2026-0453 - "P2P/NCCL regressions after kernel+driver bump" — paging eng-infra on call.
sasha: Quick triage: Is this only cross-generation (H100<->A100) or also A100<->A100 within mixed racks? We need to know if it's NVLink topology detection or driver-level P2P setup.
anita: Tested A100->A100 on same rack: some pairs OK, some pairs show SHM disabled and fall back to NET. Pattern seems correlated with kernel config and PCI assignment ordering.
mike: Workaround suggestion — set environment to force SHM and avoid NET fallback for now? `export NCCL_SHM_DISABLE=0` and `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=`? Risky.
ryan: For immediate safety, we're draining mixed-gen pools and routing jobs to homogeneous pools. Set `node:gpu.gen=A100` label to avoid mixing. I'll push cordon/evict tags.
jordan: Can we repro with nccl-tests? Anita, can you run `build/all_reduce_perf` with `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` on the two nodes that show mismatch?
anita: Running now. `NCCL INFO NET/Socket : using eth0 10.2.x.x` then after a while `NCCL WARN AllReduce : Backend terminated` — full logs attached to the incident ticket.
sasha: If discovery is flaky, a plausible root cause: kernel PCI resource allocation changed and driver can't map GPU peer mmaps -> P2P mmap fails and NCCL falls back to NET. That matches the BAR warnings.
mike: Options: 1) Roll back kernel on subset of fleet (hotfix) 2) Rebuild driver with different BAR mapping parameters 3) Force schedule to homogeneous nodes while we investigate.
ryan: I'm rolling a hotfix: pin kernel to previous image for 50 nodes in west region and watch nccl metrics. Will mark affected pools as degraded in console so product knows.
jordan: Also file with NVIDIA? Might be a regression in 535 + kernel 5.19. Need SR with vendor including `dmesg`, `lspci -vvv`, `nvidia-bug-report.sh`.
anita: I already started a bugreport. Attached `lspci` and `nvidia-bug-report`. Noted the PCI bridge reorder. NVIDIA suggested trying `pci=realloc=on` kernel arg as an experiment.
sasha: Can we try `pci=realloc=on` on a canary node before broader rollback? Less invasive.
ryan: Will try on one H100 and one A100 node. If it fixes P2P detection, we can push kernel boot arg via PXE profile to a small batch.
mike: Also, as a short-term stopgap, set `NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL=2`? Not sure it helps if P2P discovery fails earlier.
jordan: Action items: ryan - canary kernel arg + cordon 50 nodes; anita - attach nccl-tests logs to INC ticket; sasha - notify training jobs to pause and route to homogeneous pools; mike - prepare rollback plan for driver if canary fails.
anita: Logs uploaded and ticket updated with a timeline. :white_check_mark:
ryan: Can confirm canary with `pci=realloc=on` made `nvidia-smi topo -m` show NVLink again on the tested H100/A100 pair — preliminary success.
sasha: Great. Let's hold off mass rollback; apply PXE profile to second batch and monitor NCCL allreduce latency and net byte counters.
jordan: Thanks all. We'll keep the incident open until we've validated 24h of stable allreduce runs on mixed-gen workloads. Tagging @oncall for visibility. :eyes:
opsbot: closing note: #INC-2026-0453 set to monitoring. Will auto-escalate if error rate > 3% for next 2 hours.
